factReview: Review only, nothing new to teach
insideNote: A one-page note for the guest teacher: the day at a glance
insideScript: A script for each of the {n} blocks: what to say, how to start, what to do when a child is stuck
insidePages: {n} worksheets, one for every block, with a second page for early finishers and an easier page for children who need one
insideForms: A form the guest teacher fills in at the end of the day
insideClass: Class information sheets that you fill in once: schedule, routines, helpers, dismissal
teacherTitle: The whole day in one file
teacherLead: One file to send before school starts: the note and the scripts for the guest teacher, the forms, and every worksheet in the order of the day.
planNote: All three are part of the {plan} plan.
bundleHow: The file is put together on your device, so it always holds the pages as they are today.
bundleWorking: Putting your file together: page {done} of {total}
bundleFailed: The file could not be made. Please try again.
saveBtn: Save the pages to my collections

pilotBanner: Format preview. This page is not listed anywhere and search engines are asked not to index it.
pdfHello: Thank you for teaching our class today.
pdfIntro: Everything in this pack is review: the children have learned it before, and nothing new has to be taught. Each block has one worksheet for everyone and a short script on the next pages. The class information sheets at the back tell you how our day runs.
pdfBefore1: Read the class information sheets at the back of this pack.
pdfBefore2: Put the worksheets in piles in the order of the list below. Each block has a pile for everyone, a few copies of the easier page, and a pile for early finishers.
pdfBefore3: Write the list of the day on the board, so that the children can see what comes next.
pdfAny1: Read the instruction at the top of each worksheet aloud before the children start.
pdfAny2: A child who finishes early gets the page for early finishers. After that the child may read a book or draw on the back of the page.
pdfAny3: Collect every worksheet at the end of its block and leave the piles on the teacher's desk.
pdfHandOutText: {title}: the page for everyone. Keep the easier page and the page for early finishers ready.
pdfReportLead: Please fill this in at the end of the day and leave it on the desk.
pdfReportNot: What we did not get to
pdfReportHelp: Children who needed extra help, and with what
pdfReportGood: Children who were a great help today
pdfReportNotes: Anything else the teacher should know
pdfReportSign: Name of the guest teacher, date
pdfClassLead: The class teacher fills these pages in once and keeps a copy with the pack.
pdfClassSchedule: Our day: times of arrival, recess, lunch, specials and dismissal
pdfClassRoutines: Routines: attention signal, restroom, pencils, lining up
pdfClassHelpers: Who can help: a teacher next door, the office, children who know the routines
pdfClassNeeds: Children with allergies, medication or other needs (see the office for details)
pdfClassEmergency: Emergency procedures: where the plan is kept
